# Autoškola kvíz

> Bezplatný trenažér testů autoškoly pro Českou republiku: všech 1136 oficiálních zkušebních
> otázek Ministerstva dopravy (eTesty), procvičování podle okruhů, krátká denní dávka,
> opakování chyb a zkušební test ve formátu skutečné zkoušky (25 otázek, 30 minut). Každá odpověď
> je vysvětlená a odkazuje na přesné ustanovení zákona č. 361/2000 Sb. nebo vyhlášky č. 294/2015 Sb.
> (citace doslovně, s paragrafem nebo číslem značky). Animované dopravní situace jako u zkoušky.
> Bez registrace, bez reklam, bez cookies; funguje offline (PWA) i na mobilu. Česky.

## What it is
- A practice app for the Czech driving-licence theory exam ("testy autoškoly").
- Question bank: the official public exam questions of the Ministry of Transport
  (https://etesty.md.gov.cz/), 1136 questions in the official wording, grouped by okruh
  (pravidla provozu, dopravní značky, dopravní situace, zásady bezpečné jízdy, zdravotnická
  příprava, …) plus a timed mock exam.
- Every question is explained: why the official answer is right, with the sentence of law it rests
  on quoted verbatim and cited (e.g. "§ 54 odst. 3 zákona č. 361/2000 Sb.", "vyhláška č. 294/2015
  Sb., příloha č. 3, značka B 28"), linked to the consolidated text on zakonyprolidi.cz. 972 of the
  1136 explanations cite law; the rest (safe-driving technique, first aid) say why without a
  paragraph, because none states it. Quotes are checked against the stored law texts in CI.
- The 202 animated "dopravní situace" questions play their official clip.
- Learning design: free topic choice, mastery per okruh instead of grades, immediate
  self-correcting feedback; a wrong answer comes back at the end of the set until it is put right;
  missed questions resurface via spaced repetition. No streak guilt, no paywall, no lives.
- Free forever, no account needed; optional Google / magic-link sign-in only to sync progress
  between devices. Only first-party anonymous usage counts, no third-party trackers.

## How to use it
- https://autoskola.dravec.org/ — pick an okruh, run the daily set, or start a mock exam;
  progress is kept on the device.
- Mock exam in the real format (25 questions, 30 minutes, pass 43/50, points per okruh):
  https://autoskola.dravec.org/zkouska-nanecisto/
- Topic pages are real URLs, e.g. https://autoskola.dravec.org/okruh/dopravni-znacky/
- Every official question has its own page with the official answer, the explanation and the legal
  source in plain HTML: https://autoskola.dravec.org/otazka/<id>-<slug>/, e.g.
  https://autoskola.dravec.org/otazka/13-chodec-smi-vstoupit-na-prechod-pro-chodce/
  (all 1136 are listed in the sitemap and linked from their okruh page).

## Data & provenance
- Questions and answer keys are the official public bank; the app shows the official wording
  unchanged. Where current law or first-aid guidance has moved on from an official answer, the
  explanation says so (5 questions). Bank source and counts: https://autoskola.dravec.org/ (footer) and
  https://github.com/Chartres/autoskola-kviz/blob/main/data/README.md
- A study aid, not the exam: the official test is taken at the driving school / municipal office.
